verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and hierarchy, but it is cramped vertically: the headline sits about 25px from the top, the gap between the subline and the CTA is tight, and the CTA nearly reaches the bottom edge. It reads more like the original squeezed than rearranged. B blows the headline up to almost the full canvas width, so its side margins are only about 30px. It then pushes the subline (now an awkward two-line wrap) and the CTA into a right-aligned bottom row that shares no axis with the centred headline. This leaves a dead bottom-left corner, jams the CTA against the right edge and makes the headline dominate far more than in the original.
